title: Check Against Reference
text: 检查模型信号在仿真期间是否跟踪参考信号，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Times} 指定时间向量；{Show Plot} 打开绘图窗口、{Show plot on block open} 指定双击模块以打开绘图、{Response Optimization} 打开 Response Optimizer、{Include reference signal tracking in assertion} 指定检查信号是否跟踪参考信号、{Amplitudes} 指定参考信号幅值 1-exp、{Absolute tolerance} 指定信号的绝对容差 eps^、{Relative tolerance} 指定信号的相对容差、{Enable assertion} 启用或禁用检查、{Simulation callback when assertion fails (optional)} 指定断言失败时要计算的表达式、{Stop simulation when assertion fails} 指定断言失败时停止仿真、{Output assertion signal} 指定创建输出信号，按实例取值。

ports.name: Port_1 (u)
ports.summary: 要对照指定参考信号进行检查的信号 scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Show plot on block open
params.values: 双击模块以打开绘图 off (default) | on

params.name: Include reference signal tracking in assertion
params.values: 检查信号是否跟踪参考信号 on (default) | off

params.name: Times
params.values: 时间向量 linspace(0,10) (default) | vector of positive values | MATLAB expression

params.name: Amplitudes
params.values: 参考信号幅值 1-exp(-linspace(0,10)/2) (default) | vector | MATLAB expression

params.name: Absolute tolerance
params.values: 信号的绝对容差 eps^(1/3) (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Relative tolerance
params.values: 信号的相对容差 0.01 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Enable assertion
params.values: 启用或禁用检查 on (default) | off

params.name: Simulation callback when assertion fails (optional)
params.values: 断言失败时要计算的表达式 ’’ (default) | MATLAB expression

params.name: Stop simulation when assertion fails
params.values: 断言失败时停止仿真 off (default) | on

params.name: Output assertion signal
params.values: 创建输出信号 off (default) | on
